question: A student scores 450 out of 600 marks. What is the percentage?
question_ne: विद्यार्थीले ६०० मा ४५० अंक ल्याउँछ। प्रतिशत कति हो?

question: A simply supported beam of span 6 m carries a central point load of 12 kN. What is the maximum bending moment?
question_ne: ६ m स्पान भएको साधारण समर्थित बीमको बीचमा १२ kN बिन्दु भार छ। अधिकतम बेन्डिङ मोमेन्ट कति हुन्छ?
explanation: For a central point load, Mmax = PL/4 = 12 × 6 / 4 = 18 kNm.

question: The bending moment at the free end of a cantilever beam is:
question_ne: क्यान्टिलिभर बीमको स्वतन्त्र छेउमा बेन्डिङ मोमेन्ट कति हुन्छ?

question: The point of contraflexure is the point where:
question_ne: प्रतिवक्रता बिन्दु त्यो बिन्दु हो जहाँ:
explanation: At the point of contraflexure the bending moment changes sign, so it is zero.
explanation_ne: प्रतिवक्रता बिन्दुमा बेन्डिङ मोमेन्टको चिन्ह बदलिन्छ, त्यसैले यो शून्य हुन्छ।

question: The standard grade of concrete M20 means a characteristic compressive strength of:
question_ne: कंक्रिटको M20 ग्रेडको अर्थ विशेषता कम्प्रेसिभ शक्ति कति हो?

question: The water-cement ratio for normal concrete is generally in the range:
question_ne: साधारण कंक्रिटका लागि पानी-सिमेन्ट अनुपात सामान्यतया कुन दायरामा हुन्छ?
explanation: A water-cement ratio of 0.4-0.6 is typical for normal workable concrete.

question: Which test measures the workability of fresh concrete?
question_ne: ताजा कंक्रिटको कार्ययोग्यता कुन परीक्षणले मापन गर्छ?
explanation: The slump test measures the workability (consistency) of fresh concrete.

question: The line joining points of equal elevation on a map is called:
question_ne: नक्सामा समान उचाइका बिन्दुहरू जोड्ने रेखालाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: A contour line joins points of equal elevation.
explanation_ne: कन्टुर रेखाले समान उचाइका बिन्दुहरू जोड्छ।

question: The liquid limit of soil is determined by which apparatus?
question_ne: माटोको तरल सीमा कुन उपकरणले निर्धारण गरिन्छ?
explanation: The Casagrande apparatus is used to find the liquid limit of soil.

question: The maximum dry density of soil is obtained at which moisture content?
question_ne: माटोको अधिकतम सुख्खा घनत्व कुन आर्द्रतामा प्राप्त हुन्छ?
explanation: Maximum dry density occurs at the optimum moisture content in the Proctor test.
explanation_ne: प्रोक्टर परीक्षणमा अधिकतम सुख्खा घनत्व इष्टतम आर्द्रतामा हुन्छ।

question: The unit of kinematic viscosity is:
question_ne: काइनेमेटिक भिस्कोसिटीको एकाइ के हो?
explanation: Kinematic viscosity = dynamic viscosity/density, unit m²/s.
explanation_ne: काइनेमेटिक भिस्कोसिटी = गतिशील भिस्कोसिटी/घनत्व, एकाइ m²/s।

question: Bernoulli's equation is based on the conservation of:
question_ne: बर्नौली समीकरण केको संरक्षणमा आधारित छ?
explanation: Bernoulli's equation expresses conservation of energy in fluid flow.
explanation_ne: बर्नौली समीकरणले तरल प्रवाहमा ऊर्जाको संरक्षण व्यक्त गर्छ।

question: The discharge through a pipe is given by Q = A × V, where A is:
question_ne: पाइपबाट निस्कने प्रवाह Q = A × V मा A के हो?
explanation: Q = A × V, where A is the cross-sectional area and V is the velocity.

question: The standard gauge of railway track in Nepal (broad gauge) is:
question_ne: नेपालमा रेलवे ट्र्याकको मानक गेज (ब्रोड गेज) कति हो?
explanation: Broad gauge is 1676 mm (5 ft 6 in).

question: The minimum radius of a horizontal curve depends mainly on:
question_ne: तेर्सो वक्रको न्यूनतम त्रिज्या मुख्यतया केमा निर्भर गर्छ?
explanation: Minimum curve radius is governed by design speed and superelevation.

question: The main ingredient of cement is:
question_ne: सिमेन्टको मुख्य सामग्री के हो?

question: The compressive strength of a first-class brick is not less than:
question_ne: प्रथम श्रेणीको इँटाको कम्प्रेसिभ शक्ति कम्तीमा कति हुन्छ?
explanation: First-class bricks have a minimum compressive strength of about 10.5 N/mm² (commonly quoted 7.5-10.5; IS 1077 class 10 is 10 N/mm²).
explanation_ne: प्रथम श्रेणीका इँटाको न्यूनतम कम्प्रेसिभ शक्ति लगभग १०.५ N/mm² हुन्छ।

question: The unit hydrograph is used to estimate:
question_ne: एकाइ हाइड्रोग्राफ के अनुमान गर्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation: A unit hydrograph gives the direct runoff from 1 cm of effective rainfall.
explanation_ne: एकाइ हाइड्रोग्राफले १ cm प्रभावकारी वर्षाबाट प्रत्यक्ष बहाव दिन्छ।

question: The unit of measurement for brickwork is:

explanation: Brickwork is measured in cubic metres.
explanation_ne: इँटाको काम घन मिटरमा मापन गरिन्छ।

question: The moment of inertia of a rectangular section (b × d) about its centroidal axis parallel to the base is:
question_ne: आधारसँग समानान्तर केन्द्रीय अक्षबारे आयताकार खण्ड (b × d) को जडत्व आघूर्ण कति हो?
explanation: For a rectangle, I = bd³/12 about the centroidal axis parallel to the base.
explanation_ne: आयतका लागि, आधारसँग समानान्तर केन्द्रीय अक्षबारे I = bd³/12 हुन्छ।

question: The per capita water demand for a Nepali town is usually taken as:
question_ne: नेपाली सहरका लागि प्रतिव्यक्ति पानी माग सामान्यतया कति लिइन्छ?
explanation: About 135 litres per capita per day is commonly used for urban water supply design in Nepal.
explanation_ne: नेपालमा सहरी खानेपानी डिजाइनका लागि लगभग १३५ लिटर प्रतिव्यक्ति प्रतिदिन प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

question: The most common method of water disinfection is:
question_ne: पानी शुद्धीकरणको सबैभन्दा सामान्य विधि कुन हो?
explanation: Chlorination is the most widely used method of disinfecting public water supplies.
explanation_ne: क्लोरिनेसन सार्वजनिक खानेपानी शुद्धीकरणको सबैभन्दा व्यापक विधि हो।

question: The duty of water is defined as:
question_ne: पानीको ड्युटी के हो?
options_ne: प्रति एकाइ प्रवाह सिँचाइ गरिएको क्षेत्र
explanation: Duty is the area irrigated by one cumec of water during the base period.

question: The full form of BOD is:
question_ne: BOD को पूर्ण रूप के हो?
explanation: BOD stands for Biochemical Oxygen Demand.
explanation_ne: BOD को अर्थ जैवरासायनिक अक्सिजन माग हो।

question: The full form of COD is:
question_ne: COD को पूर्ण रूप के हो?
explanation: COD stands for Chemical Oxygen Demand.
explanation_ne: COD को अर्थ रासायनिक अक्सिजन माग हो।

question: For a cantilever beam of length L with a point load P at the free end, the maximum deflection is:
question_ne: L लम्बाइको क्यान्टिलिभर बीमको स्वतन्त्र छेउमा P बिन्दु भार हुँदा अधिकतम विक्षेपण कति हुन्छ?

question: The error due to curvature of the Earth is corrected in:
question_ne: पृथ्वीको वक्रताका कारण हुने त्रुटि कुनमा सच्याइन्छ?
explanation: Geodetic surveying accounts for the Earth's curvature; plane surveying ignores it.
explanation_ne: जियोडेटिक सर्वेक्षणले पृथ्वीको वक्रता हिसाब गर्छ; प्लेन सर्वेक्षणले बेवास्ता गर्छ।

question: The standard size of a modular brick in Nepal/India is:
question_ne: नेपाल/भारतमा मोड्युलर इँटाको मानक आकार कति हो?
explanation: The standard modular brick size is 190 × 90 × 90 mm.
explanation_ne: मानक मोड्युलर इँटाको आकार १९० × ९० × ९० mm हो।

question: The plasticity index of soil is:
question_ne: माटोको प्लास्टिसिटी इन्डेक्स के हो?
explanation: Plasticity index = liquid limit − plastic limit.
explanation_ne: प्लास्टिसिटी इन्डेक्स = तरल सीमा − प्लास्टिक सीमा।

question: The Reynolds number for laminar flow in a pipe is less than:
question_ne: पाइपमा लामिनार प्रवाहका लागि रेनल्ड्स संख्या कति भन्दा कम हुन्छ?
explanation: Flow in a pipe is laminar when the Reynolds number is below about 2000.

question: The average annual rainfall in Nepal is approximately:
question_ne: नेपालमा औसत वार्षिक वर्षा लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation: Nepal receives about 1500 mm of average annual rainfall.

question: A truss member carrying tensile force is called a:
question_ne: तनाव बल बोक्ने ट्रस सदस्यलाई के भनिन्छ?

question: Two resistors of 4 Ω and 6 Ω in parallel have an equivalent resistance of:
question_ne: ४ Ω र ६ Ω का दुई प्रतिरोधक समानान्तरमा जोड्दा समतुल्य प्रतिरोध कति हुन्छ?

question: The unit of electric power is:
question_ne: विद्युतीय शक्तिको एकाइ के हो?

question: A 100 W bulb is used for 10 hours. How much energy is consumed?
question_ne: 100 W को बल्ब १० घण्टा बाल्दा कति ऊर्जा खपत हुन्छ?
explanation: Energy = 100 W × 10 h = 1000 Wh = 1 kWh (1 unit).

question: The power factor of a purely resistive circuit is:
question_ne: शुद्ध प्रतिरोधात्मक परिपथको पावर फ्याक्टर कति हुन्छ?
explanation: In a purely resistive circuit voltage and current are in phase, so power factor = 1.
explanation_ne: शुद्ध प्रतिरोधात्मक परिपथमा भोल्टेज र विद्युत् एउटै फेजमा हुन्छन्, त्यसैले पावर फ्याक्टर = 1।

question: In a purely inductive circuit, current lags voltage by:
question_ne: शुद्ध प्रेरकीय परिपथमा विद्युत् भोल्टेजभन्दा कतिले पछाडि हुन्छ?
explanation: In a pure inductor, current lags voltage by 90°.
explanation_ne: शुद्ध इन्डक्टरमा विद्युत् भोल्टेजभन्दा ९०° पछाडि हुन्छ।

question: A transformer works on the principle of:
question_ne: ट्रान्सफर्मर कुन सिद्धान्तमा काम गर्छ?
explanation: A transformer works on mutual induction between primary and secondary windings.
explanation_ne: ट्रान्सफर्मर प्राथमिक र द्वितीयक वाइन्डिङबीचको पारस्परिक प्रेरणमा काम गर्छ।

question: The synchronous speed of a 4-pole, 50 Hz induction motor is:

question: The slip of an induction motor at synchronous speed is:

question: Which motor is used in a ceiling fan?

question: A diode allows current to flow in:
question_ne: डायोडले कुन दिशामा विद्युत् प्रवाह गर्न दिन्छ?
explanation: A diode conducts current in the forward direction only.

question: The full form of MOSFET is:

question: The voltage level of NEA transmission lines in Nepal is typically:

question: The colour of the earth wire in Nepal is:
question_ne: नेपालमा अर्थ तारको रङ के हो?

question: Which instrument measures electric current?
question_ne: विद्युतीय विद्युत् प्रवाह कुन यन्त्रले मापन गर्छ?
explanation: An ammeter measures electric current.

question: A voltmeter is connected in which way in a circuit?

explanation: A voltmeter is connected in parallel across the component.

question: The resonant frequency of an RLC series circuit is given by:
question_ne: RLC श्रृंखला परिपथको अनुनाद आवृत्ति कुन सूत्रले दिइन्छ?
explanation: Resonance occurs at f = 1/(2π√LC).

question: Kirchhoff's current law is based on the conservation of:
question_ne: किरचफको विद्युत् नियम केको संरक्षणमा आधारित छ?
explanation: KCL is based on conservation of charge: the sum of currents at a node is zero.

question_ne: सम्पत्तिको स्वामित्व कसरी प्राप्त गर्न सकिन्छ?
options: Sale, gift, inheritance or adverse possession
options_ne: बिक्री, दान, उत्तराधिकार वा प्रतिकूल कब्जा
explanation: Ownership is acquired by sale, gift, inheritance, will or adverse possession.
explanation_ne: स्वामित्व बिक्री, दान, उत्तराधिकार, इच्छापत्र वा प्रतिकूल कब्जाबाट प्राप्त गर्न सकिन्छ।

question: Adverse possession in Nepal generally requires continuous possession for:
question_ne: नेपालमा प्रतिकूल कब्जाका लागि सामान्यतया कति समय निरन्तर कब्जा चाहिन्छ?
explanation: Adverse possession generally requires 12 years of continuous, open and hostile possession.
explanation_ne: प्रतिकूल कब्जाका लागि सामान्यतया १२ वर्ष निरन्तर, खुला र शत्रुतापूर्ण कब्जा चाहिन्छ।

question: Defamation means:
question_ne: मानहानी के हो?
options: A false statement harming a person's reputation
options_ne: व्यक्तिको प्रतिष्ठामा हानि पुर्‍याउने झुटो बयान
explanation: Defamation is a false statement that harms a person's reputation.
explanation_ne: मानहानी भनेको व्यक्तिको प्रतिष्ठामा हानि पुर्‍याउने झूटो कथन हो।

question: Negligence in tort law means:
question_ne: अपकृत्य कानूनमा लापरबाही के हो?
explanation: Negligence is the failure to exercise reasonable care, causing harm to another.
explanation_ne: लापरबाही भनेको उचित सावधानी नअपनाउनु हो, जसले अर्कोलाई हानि पुर्‍याउँछ।

question: An agreement without consideration is generally:
question_ne: प्रतिफलबिना भएको सम्झौता सामान्यतया कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation: An agreement without consideration is generally void, except in specified cases.
explanation_ne: प्रतिफलबिना भएको सम्झौता सामान्यतया शून्य हुन्छ, तोकिएका अवस्थामा बाहेक।

question: Under Nepali law, a son and a daughter have:
question_ne: नेपाली कानूनअनुसार छोरा र छोरीको अधिकार कस्तो छ?
explanation: Sons and daughters have equal rights to parental property under Nepali law.
explanation_ne: नेपाली कानूनअनुसार छोरा र छोरीको पैतृक सम्पत्तिमा समान अधिकार छ।

question: A contract whose object is unlawful is:
question_ne: जसको उद्देश्य गैरकानुनी छ, त्यस्तो करार कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation: A contract with an unlawful object is void.
explanation_ne: गैरकानुनी उद्देश्य भएको करार शून्य हुन्छ।

question: Divorce in Nepal can be obtained by:
question_ne: नेपालमा सम्बन्धविच्छेद कसरी प्राप्त गर्न सकिन्छ?
explanation: Either spouse may seek divorce on the grounds specified in the Muluki Civil Code 2074.
explanation_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता २०७४ मा तोकिएका आधारमा कुनै पनि पक्षले सम्बन्धविच्छेद माग्न सक्छ।

question: The court of first instance for most civil cases in Nepal is the:
question_ne: नेपालमा धेरैजसो देवानी मुद्दाको पहिलो अदालत कुन हो?
explanation: The District Court is the court of first instance for most civil cases.
explanation_ne: जिल्ला अदालत धेरैजसो देवानी मुद्दाको पहिलो अदालत हो।

question: The limitation period for filing an appeal to the High Court is generally:
question_ne: उच्च अदालतमा पुनरावेदन दायर गर्ने हद म्याद सामान्यतया कति हो?
explanation: An appeal to the High Court must generally be filed within 30 days.
explanation_ne: उच्च अदालतमा पुनरावेदन सामान्यतया ३० दिनभित्र दायर गर्नुपर्छ।

question: Quantum meruit means:
question_ne: क्वान्टम मेरुइट के हो?
explanation: Quantum meruit means payment for as much as one has deserved — reasonable value of work done.
explanation_ne: क्वान्टम मेरुइट भनेको गरिएको कामको उचित मूल्य अनुसार भुक्तानी हो।

question: A gift of immovable property must be made by:
question_ne: अचल सम्पत्तिको दान कसरी गर्नुपर्छ?
explanation: A gift of immovable property must be made by a registered deed.
explanation_ne: अचल सम्पत्तिको दान दर्ता भएको लिखतद्वारा गर्नुपर्छ।

question: Adoption in Nepal is governed by:
question_ne: नेपालमा धर्मपुत्र/धर्मपुत्री ग्रहण कुन कानूनले नियमन गर्छ?
explanation: Adoption is governed by the Muluki Civil Code 2074 and the Children's Act 2075.
explanation_ne: धर्मपुत्र ग्रहण मुलुकी देवानी संहिता २०७४ र बालबालिका सम्बन्धी ऐन २०७५ द्वारा नियमन गरिन्छ।

question: Trespass to land means:
question_ne: जग्गामा अतिक्रमण के हो?
explanation: Trespass is the unlawful entry onto another person's land.
explanation_ne: अतिक्रमण भनेको अर्को व्यक्तिको जग्गामा गैरकानुनी प्रवेश हो।

question: A proposal becomes a promise when it is:
question_ne: प्रस्ताव कहिले प्रतिज्ञा बन्छ?
explanation: A proposal becomes a promise when it is accepted.
explanation_ne: प्रस्ताव स्वीकार गरिएपछि प्रतिज्ञा बन्छ।

question: The doctrine of lis pendens means:
question_ne: लिस पेन्डेन्स सिद्धान्त के हो?
options: Property cannot be transferred during pending litigation
options_ne: मुद्दा विचाराधीन रहँदा सम्पत्ति हस्तान्तरण गर्न सकिँदैन
explanation: Lis pendens means property under litigation cannot be transferred to defeat the suit.
explanation_ne: लिस पेन्डेन्सको अर्थ मुद्दा विचाराधीन रहेको सम्पत्ति मुद्दालाई हराउन हस्तान्तरण गर्न सकिँदैन।

question: Mediation in Nepal is a process of:
question_ne: नेपालमा मध्यस्थता के प्रक्रिया हो?
options: Voluntary settlement with a neutral mediator
explanation: Mediation is a voluntary process where a neutral mediator helps parties settle.
explanation_ne: मध्यस्थता स्वैच्छिक प्रक्रिया हो जहाँ तटस्थ मध्यस्थकर्ताले पक्षहरूलाई सम्झौता गर्न मद्दत गर्छ।

question: A will is also known as:
question_ne: इच्छापत्रलाई के पनि भनिन्छ?
explanation: A will is also called a testament.
explanation_ne: इच्छापत्रलाई वसीयतनामा पनि भनिन्छ।

question: Under the Muluki Criminal Code 2074, a child below the age of 10 years committing an act is:
question_ne: मुलुकी अपराध संहिता २०७४ अनुसार १० वर्षमुनिको बालकले गरेको कार्य कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation: An act by a child below 10 years is not an offence under the Code.
explanation_ne: १० वर्षमुनिको बालकले गरेको कार्य संहिताअनुसार अपराध होइन।

question: Theft is defined as:
question_ne: चोरी के हो?
options: Dishonestly taking movable property of another
explanation: Theft is the dishonest taking of another person's movable property.
explanation_ne: चोरी भनेको अर्को व्यक्तिको चल सम्पत्ति बेइमानीपूर्वक लिनु हो।

question: Robbery differs from theft because it involves:
question_ne: डकैती चोरीभन्दा फरक छ किनकि यसमा के हुन्छ?
explanation: Robbery is theft with the use or threat of force.
explanation_ne: डकैती भनेको बल वा धम्की प्रयोग गरेर गरिएको चोरी हो।

question: Mens rea means:
question_ne: मेन्स रिया के हो?
explanation: Mens rea is the guilty mind or criminal intent behind an act.
explanation_ne: मेन्स रिया भनेको कार्य पछाडिको दोषी मन वा आपराधिक नियत हो।

question: Actus reus means:
question_ne: एक्टस रियस के हो?
explanation: Actus reus is the guilty act — the physical element of a crime.
explanation_ne: एक्टस रियस भनेको दोषी कार्य हो — अपराधको भौतिक तत्व।

question: An attempt to commit an offence is punishable with:
question_ne: अपराध गर्ने प्रयासको सजाय कति हुन्छ?
options: Half of the punishment for the completed offence
explanation: An attempt is generally punishable with half the punishment of the completed offence.
explanation_ne: प्रयासको सजाय सामान्यतया पूरा अपराधको सजायको आधा हुन्छ।

question: Abetment of an offence means:
question_ne: अपराधको दुरुत्साहन के हो?
options: Instigating or aiding the commission of an offence
options_ne: अपराध गर्न उक्साउने वा सहयोग गर्ने
explanation: Abetment means instigating, conspiring or aiding the commission of an offence.
explanation_ne: दुरुत्साहन भनेको अपराध गर्न उक्साउने, षड्यन्त्र गर्ने वा सहयोग गर्ने हो।

question: The first information report (FIR) is filed with the:
question_ne: प्रथम सूचना प्रतिवेदन (FIR) कहाँ दायर गरिन्छ?
explanation: An FIR is lodged with the police.
explanation_ne: FIR प्रहरीमा दायर गरिन्छ।

question: Rape under Nepali law is punishable with imprisonment of:
question_ne: नेपाली कानूनअनुसार बलात्कारको सजाय कति कैद हो?
options: 10 to 15 years depending on the victim's age
options_ne: १० to १५ years depending on the victim's age
explanation: Rape is punishable with 10-15 years (up to 20 years in aggravated cases) depending on the victim's age and circumstances.
explanation_ne: बलात्कारमा पीडितको उमेर र परिस्थितिअनुसार १०-१५ वर्ष (गम्भीर अवस्थामा २० वर्षसम्म) कैद सजाय हुन्छ।

question: Corruption by a public servant is investigated by:
question_ne: सार्वजनिक पदाधिकारीको भ्रष्टाचार कसले अनुसन्धान गर्छ?
options: Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA)
options_ne: Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA)
explanation: The CIAA investigates corruption by public office holders.
explanation_ne: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोगले सार्वजनिक पदाधिकारीको भ्रष्टाचार अनुसन्धान गर्छ।

question: The principle 'ignorance of law is no excuse' means:
question_ne: 'कानूनको अज्ञानता क्षम्य छैन' सिद्धान्तको अर्थ के हो?
options: No one can escape liability by claiming ignorance of law
options_ne: कानूनको अज्ञानता दाबी गरेर कोही पनि दायित्वबाट उम्कन सक्दैन
explanation: Ignorantia juris non excusat — ignorance of the law does not excuse an offence.
explanation_ne: कानूनको अज्ञानताले अपराधबाट उन्मुक्ति दिँदैन।

question: Bail is generally granted in:
question_ne: जमानत सामान्यतया कुन अवस्थामा दिइन्छ?
explanation: Bail is granted as a matter of right in bailable offences.
explanation_ne: जमानतयोग्य अपराधमा जमानत अधिकारको रूपमा दिइन्छ।

question: The main investigating authority for criminal offences in Nepal is:
question_ne: नेपालमा फौजदारी अपराधको मुख्य अनुसन्धान निकाय कुन हो?
explanation: Nepal Police is the main investigating authority for criminal offences.
explanation_ne: नेपाल प्रहरी फौजदारी अपराधको मुख्य अनुसन्धान निकाय हो।

question: The writ of habeas corpus is used to:
question_ne: बन्दी प्रत्यक्षीकरणको रिट के गर्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options: Secure the release of a person unlawfully detained
options_ne: गैरकानुनी रूपमा थुनामा परेको व्यक्तिको रिहाइ सुनिश्चित गर्ने
सार्वजनिक कर्तव्य पालन गर्न बाध्य पार्ने
explanation: Habeas corpus secures the release of a person unlawfully detained.
explanation_ne: बन्दी प्रत्यक्षीकरणले गैरकानुनी रूपमा थुनामा रहेको व्यक्तिलाई मुक्त गराउँछ।
source: Nepal Bar Council syllabus: Legal Principles

question: The writ of mandamus is issued to:
question_ne: परमादेशको रिट कसलाई जारी गरिन्छ?
options: Compel a public authority to perform its duty
options_ne: सार्वजनिक निकायलाई आफ्नो कर्तव्य पालन गर्न बाध्य पार्ने
explanation: Mandamus compels a public authority to perform a public duty.
explanation_ne: परमादेशले सार्वजनिक निकायलाई आफ्नो कर्तव्य पूरा गर्न बाध्य पार्छ।
source: Nepal Bar Council syllabus: Legal Principles

question: The writ of certiorari is issued to:
question_ne: उत्प्रेषणको रिट के गर्न जारी गरिन्छ?
options: Quash the order of a lower court or tribunal
options_ne: तल्लो अदालत वा न्यायाधिकरणको आदेश बदर गर्ने
explanation: Certiorari quashes the order of a lower court or tribunal acting without jurisdiction.
explanation_ne: उत्प्रेषणले अधिकार क्षेत्रबाहिर काम गरेको तल्लो अदालत वा न्यायाधिकरणको आदेश बदर गर्छ।
source: Nepal Bar Council syllabus: Legal Principles

question: The writ of prohibition is used to:
question_ne: निषेधाज्ञाको रिट के गर्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options: Prevent a lower court from exceeding its jurisdiction
options_ne: तल्लो अदालतलाई आफ्नो क्षेत्राधिकार नाघ्नबाट रोक्ने
explanation: Prohibition prevents a lower court or tribunal from exceeding its jurisdiction.
explanation_ne: निषेधाज्ञाले तल्लो अदालत वा न्यायाधिकरणलाई अधिकार क्षेत्र नाघ्नबाट रोक्छ।
source: Nepal Bar Council syllabus: Legal Principles

question: The writ of quo warranto is used to:
question_ne: अधिकार पृच्छाको रिट के गर्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options: Challenge a person's right to hold a public office
options_ne: सार्वजनिक पद धारण गर्ने व्यक्तिको अधिकारलाई चुनौती दिने
explanation: Quo warranto challenges a person's legal right to hold a public office.
explanation_ne: अधिकार पृच्छाले व्यक्तिको सार्वजनिक पद धारण गर्ने कानुनी अधिकारलाई चुनौती दिन्छ।
source: Nepal Bar Council syllabus: Legal Principles

question: The hierarchy of courts in Nepal from lowest to highest is:
question_ne: नेपालमा अदालतको पदानुक्रम तल्लोदेखि माथिसम्म कस्तो छ?
options: Supreme Court - High Court - District Court
District Court - High Court - Supreme Court
High Court - District Court - Supreme Court
District Court - Supreme Court - High Court
options_ne: Supreme Court - High Court - District Court
District Court - High Court - Supreme Court
High Court - District Court - Supreme Court
District Court - Supreme Court - High Court
explanation: The hierarchy is District Court, High Court, then the Supreme Court.
explanation_ne: पदानुक्रम जिल्ला अदालत, उच्च अदालत, त्यसपछि सर्वोच्च अदालत हो।
source: Nepal Bar Council syllabus: Legal Principles

question: The doctrine of precedent (stare decisis) means:
question_ne: नजिरको सिद्धान्त (स्टेयर डिसिसिस) के हो?
options: Courts follow decisions of higher courts in similar cases
options_ne: अदालतहरूले समान मुद्दामा माथिल्लो अदालतका निर्णयहरू पालना गर्छन्
हरेक मुद्दा नयाँ रूपमा निर्णय गरिन्छ
explanation: Stare decisis requires courts to follow the precedents set by higher courts.
explanation_ne: स्टेयर डिसिसिसले अदालतहरूलाई उच्च अदालतले स्थापना गरेका नजिरहरू पालना गर्न बाध्य पार्छ।
source: Nepal Bar Council syllabus: Legal Principles

question: Natural justice requires that:
question_ne: प्राकृतिक न्यायले के आवश्यक ठान्छ?
options: Only the rich get a hearing
No one should be a judge in his own cause and both sides must be heard
options_ne: कोही पनि आफ्नै मुद्दामा न्यायाधीश हुनु हुँदैन र दुवै पक्षको सुनुवाइ हुनुपर्छ
explanation: Natural justice requires audi alteram partem (hear the other side) and nemo judex in causa sua (no one judges his own cause).
explanation_ne: प्राकृतिक न्यायले अर्को पक्षलाई सुन्नुपर्छ र कोही आफ्नै मुद्दामा न्यायाधीश हुनु हुँदैन भन्छ।
source: Nepal Bar Council syllabus: Legal Principles

question: The Nepal Bar Council is responsible for:
question_ne: नेपाल बार काउन्सिल केका लागि जिम्मेवार छ?
options: Licensing advocates and regulating the legal profession
options_ne: अधिवक्ताहरूलाई इजाजतपत्र दिने र कानुनी पेशा नियमन गर्ने
explanation: The Nepal Bar Council licenses advocates and regulates the legal profession.
explanation_ne: नेपाल बार काउन्सिलले अधिवक्ताहरूलाई लाइसेन्स दिन्छ र कानुनी पेशा नियमन गर्छ।
source: Nepal Bar Council syllabus: Legal Principles

question: What are the roots of x² - 5x + 6 = 0?
question_ne: x² - 5x + 6 = 0 का मूलहरू के हुन्?
explanation: Factorising: (x - 2)(x - 3) = 0, so x = 2 or 3.
explanation_ne: गुणनखण्ड गर्दा: (x - 2)(x - 3) = 0, त्यसैले x = 2 वा 3।

question: What are the roots of x² - 6x + 5 = 0?
question_ne: x² - 6x + 5 = 0 का मूलहरू के हुन्?
explanation: Factorising: (x - 1)(x - 5) = 0, so x = 1 or 5.
explanation_ne: गुणनखण्ड गर्दा: (x - 1)(x - 5) = 0, त्यसैले x = 1 वा 5।

question: What are the roots of x² - 10x + 24 = 0?
